text.en:
SUBORDINATE COURTS ACT (CHAPTER 6)

NOTIFICATION OF APPOINTMENT OF COURT HOUSE

UNDER SECTION 4 GN 377/2006 GN 344/2008

REVISED EDITION 2013

LAWS OF BRUNEI Subordinate Courts CAP. 6, N 2 1 [Subsidiary]

SUBSIDIARY LEGISLATION Notification of appointment of court house under section 4 His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan has been graciously pleased to appoint the Law and Courts Building, Bandar Seri Begawan as a court house of the Court of a Magistrate and a Juvenile Court.
